# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It brings variable fonts, animated WebP, color font palettes, safer singleton lifecycles, and corrected pixel access. This is a breaking release: legacy paint and font APIs are removed from the reference surface, and text, stream, Vulkan, WebAssembly, and Tizen consumers should review the migrations below.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy paint and font APIs are compile errors** — Pre-v4 SKPaint text and font members, paint-state-reading overloads, glyph-query helpers, run-buffer methods, and legacy backend-target constructors are removed from the reference surface. Move text state to SKFont, pass SKSamplingOptions and SKTextAlign explicitly, and use the documented replacement properties and constructors. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **SKFilterQuality and SKPaintHinting leave the reference surface** — The obsolete enums can no longer be referenced when compiling against v4. Replace SKFilterQuality with SKSamplingOptions and SKPaintHinting with SKFontHinting. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **Default SKFont instances use an empty typeface** — new SKFont() now holds SKTypeface.Empty, so text measures to zero and does not draw. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default or another explicit typeface, and use Typeface.IsEmpty rather than a null check to detect an unset face.
- **Default paint and missing-family typefaces are non-null** — new SKPaint().Typeface and SKPaint.Reset() now yield SKTypeface.Default, while SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns the default face for an unknown Android family. Stop using null to detect these states; use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when a strict missing-family result is required.
- **SKStream.Move(long) validates its range** — Move(long) is obsolete and throws OverflowException instead of truncating offsets outside the 32-bit native range. Validate the offset and call Move(int).
- **Ganesh Vulkan requires Vulkan 1.1** — Creating a Ganesh context with Vulkan 1.0 can terminate the process instead of returning null. Create the VkInstance with API version 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same supported version; choose another backend for 1.0-only hardware.
- **Vulkan backend interop fields are removed** — GRVkBackendContextNative no longer has fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, or fOwnsInstanceAndDevice. Delete those assignments, use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2, and manage instance and device ownership outside the context.
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion layout and type change** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, the compatibility GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value equality, and the native layout gains Components. Update type names, equality logic, and any manual struct construction or interop layout assumptions. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **IgnorePublicDispose is no longer settable** — SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose loses its protected setter. Derived wrappers must no longer change this disposal state directly and should follow the supported ownership and disposal patterns. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8** — Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later before upgrading. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **32-bit Tizen native assets are removed** — The tizen-arm and tizen-x86 native packages are no longer produced. Move Tizen deployments to the supported tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Assembly version advances to 4.148.0.0** — SkiaSharp.dll moves from assembly version 3.119.0.0 to 4.148.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and hard-coded assembly-version checks when adopting v4. ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 to m148** — The bundled engine adds the RF16 single-channel half-float color type and brings newer image orientation, HDR, wide-gamut, raster, and filter behavior. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Bundled image and font libraries are refreshed** — Updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, and libjpeg-turbo to newer upstream releases. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp can query variation axes, clone faces at design coordinates, select color palettes, and override palette entries. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and stream-backed SKData** — SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences, while SKStream.GetData() exposes cheaply available backing data without an intermediate managed copy. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New path, rendering, document, GPU, and color APIs** — Adds SKPathBuilder, SKSamplingOptions surface draws, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, SKDocument.CreateXps, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, and SKColorType.RF16. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor coordinates and shared-buffer stride** — SKPixmap and SKBitmap now calculate offsets and lengths from width and RowBytes, returning the correct pixels for non-square images and extracted subsets. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Default typefaces initialize safely on Android** — Default typeface resolution moves through the managed font manager and falls back to an empty typeface instead of crashing. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **SKPath finalization no longer races its builder** — Disposal avoids flushing an SKPathBuilder after finalization begins, preventing a native crash when the builder is collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI and Android view startup is more reliable** — The WinUI projection DLL resolves for .NET 9 consumers, and reattached Android SKGLView controls retain their dimensions after navigation or tab switches. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton initialization and teardown are hardened** — Singleton wrappers initialize independently, no longer free process-global native objects, and remain alive across native calls to prevent initialization deadlocks, heap corruption, and in-flight use-after-free. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native compatibility checks run at first interop use** — The version gate no longer loads libSkiaSharp during assembly initialization, preserving the opportunity to configure native-library resolution first. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic assets for x64 and arm64** — Dedicated linux-bionic runtime assets support Linux environments based on Android's Bionic libc. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen moves to 64-bit native assets** — Adds tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 packages while retiring the 32-bit Tizen targets. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Apple library workloads remain broadly compatible** — Versioned library TFMs use the base 26.0 workload instead of requiring Xcode 26.2, while app projects select the installed workload. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 updates the bundled engine from 8.3.1.5 with improved OpenType shaping, CFF2 subsetting, and font-table handling. It also adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces HBColor, and shares the hardened native-wrapper lifecycle.
